statement: N-0034 architecture (engineering call delegated by D-b): per-fact field list comes from a server-side GRID_FIELDS registry (app/services/grid_fields.py, GET /api/v1/grid-fields/{grid_id}) generalising the inbound-shipments optional-columns endpoint; fact_row_dict merges mapper columns under existing serializers so list and payload share one source; customer_code/distributor_code as default-hidden Reference fields; web hook useFactColumns + FactColumnPicker wrapping ColumnPickerDialog; localStorage persistence; no migration.
